title: Replace vulnerable shipped RSA arithmetic with installed platform providers

criteria: No RustCrypto rsa package remains selected; unchanged advisory check passes with an immutable database receipt.

Generated RSA3072 and existing PKCS8 identities complete real TLS; malformed and mismatched keys, corrupt private components, untrusted and expired certificates and wrong hostnames fail closed; ALPN remains negotiated.
Platform provider source is reviewed; no foreign crypto implementation source is bundled. Windows/macOS execution is reported separately from Linux evidence.
Integration and immutable production qualification, installed health, real inference and rollback remain required before promotion.

The locked normal graphs for Linux, Windows MSVC and Apple require their actual platform TLS providers and DER encoders, retain Wasmi/Candle and retired-backend checks, and forbid vulnerable RustCrypto rsa.

notes: Preserve accepted A/B artifacts, source and qualification receipts. No advisory ignore, baseline refresh, historical claim fabrication or target-gated vulnerable dependency. New native commits retain the actual LOCAL trailer; hosted provenance migration is a separate unresolved gate.

graph_gate_repair.method: Pinned rustc --edition 2021 --test tests/zc_matrix.rs with CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR and pinned CARGO; exact existing std-only test file, locked normal target graphs.
